Before you ask

Straight answers.

How long does it take?

Typically 14 days from the day we receive your brief.

How much of my time do you need?

One brief at the start. After that we only come back to you if something needs clarifying.

Do I need hosting or an existing website?

No. Neither is required.

Can I use my existing ad accounts and tools?

Yes. We build inside what you already have where it makes sense.

Which ad platforms do you support?

Meta, Google, TikTok, Microsoft and LinkedIn, among others. You choose up to three.

Who owns what you build?

You do. The site, the accounts, the automations and all access are yours.

Is the copywriting included?

Yes, for the website and the email sequences.

Can I edit things after launch?

Yes. You get instructions for managing everything yourself.

What support do I get after handover?

We answer questions and make reasonable adjustments.

Are there extra costs?

Nothing beyond the quoted price. Your ad spend is separate and goes to the platforms.

What about revisions and refunds?

Reasonable revisions are included. Refunds are available only within 24 hours of purchase and before work begins; after that, sales are final. The Terms and Conditions govern the details.
